reasons.reader_question: The first ladder strikes just as new pairs stagger at thorn-cuts, so the question of whether they can fight bound is sharp and immediate.
reasons.change: Crown leaf mostly burned, queen bound to Usha, Neela refuses command publicly; power, knowledge and relationships all shift.
reasons.romance_movement: Public naming of Devan as chosen is new and costly; the 'Left side' callback pays off ch23 without repeating it.
reasons.shown_chemistry: Fingers on her bound hand, Devan's open-choice question, 'Left side'/'I know where it is' show it; one narrated line explains it.
reasons.character_logic: Queen deferring the writ for the line's sake and Neela confessing the Kamalakshi leash are smart; Devan's public question is shrewd pressure.
reasons.stakes_and_cost: Every naming has a visible price: Bhaskaran's raw fingers, the queen's welt, Neela holding a page she swore off.
reasons.prose: Concrete and varied, with strong lines; one muddled ledger paragraph and a few told beats ('louder than a speech') weaken it.
reasons.continuity: 'Four unready, two unbound, and the rest tied' leaves only Kamalakshi unnamed among the Company, conflicting with F967 (eleven of forty unnamed) and the beat's 'most'.

fixes: 'Four unready, two unbound, and the rest tied': continuity conflict with F967 and the beat ('most of the forty'). Show that several Company members also hold back, perhaps naming two such as Meenu. Leave their Resin House pages unburned on Neela's knee too. Change the accounting line to fit, and let Neela's promise to Kamalakshi cover all of them: 'At first light I read every one of these back.'

'She saw Pavi's leaf curl to black beside Thilak's face': this is a muddled, told ledger paragraph. The leaf is on her knee, not beside Thilak, and the logic is hard to follow. Replace it with one concrete image and a choice. For example, she sets each saved intake roll under the board in order and counts the pairs aloud to Devan, who repeats the count back.

'In front of three hundred spears, that was louder than a speech.': this narration labels the gesture instead of showing a response. Cut the line. Show Neela turning her bound hand so his fingers rest against her palm, or have Kuttu's grin fade on the wall. Also revise 'No one in the green sashes had been called anything in years but a number': Usha volunteered her own name in ch2 (F747).
reader_question: Can the newly bound odiyans and their partners hold the shelf when every cut lands twice?
new_facts_assessment: All four are necessary and consistent. Kamalakshi's page dramatises the ledger handover rule (daylight reading) and Neela's vow. Bhaskaran's raw fingers fit the resin burn rule. Usha's torn seam explains the queen's welt (F951). Neela's pull toward the offer earns the refusal. The draft also implies members handed Neela their pages. That makes her a temporary holder for every member who doesn't name, so it must match the count of unnamed members.
